title: How to get buff GF (Dating & Relationships Q&A)
summary: Three-hour dating and relationships Q&A stream where NH answers viewer questions on flirting, the 'window of opportunity', body count, breakups, boundaries, grief and attachment styles, mixing in personal anecdotes (his playboy phase, fumbled first chances, choosing his wife). A few fitness asides cover sleep, training legs for longevity, getting partners into training and slow bulks for a formerly fat partner.
claims: He goes to bed before midnight every day; late-night internet use steals sleep that would be more productive
Ban screens and doomscrolling for at least 1.5 hours before bed and read a book instead
He doubts the claim that going to bed after midnight costs growth hormone; total sleep hours matter
In rows and rack pulls the shoulder blades should not stay static; the scapulae protract forward as the traps stretch under heavy load
50 cm arms are possible for a 6-foot natural at a reasonable body fat
42 cm biceps at 17 years old is good
To get a reluctant girlfriend training without the 'getting big' fear, start her on bodyweight movements at home and only bring her to the gym once she catches the bug
Leg training does not boost hormones enough to grow the upper body; train legs because big legs are core and the muscle built in your 20s-30s keeps you robust and mobile in your 70s-80s
His 95-year-old grandfather still carries heavy things and cuts trees because he has lots of muscle, while people inactive since their 30s cannot stand from a chair in their 60s
French gyms like Basic-Fit have poor equipment and the average lifter is about 160-170 lb, versus often 190 lb and buff in US gyms
A good diet is a sustainable diet; find the one that works for you
Tofu is a good protein source
His schedule before the layoff: work 8:00-18:00, gym 18:00-20:00, then family time, weekends for family, plus a daily walk with his wife
Learn to talk to women by talking to them and being bad at it; you must go through the embarrassment
After quitting porn, occasional masturbation is fine to avoid frustration that makes you unattractive
Men often like the chase rather than the woman, so interest vanishes once she reciprocates
Flirting is injecting sexual tension and ambiguity; without it you friendzone yourself; flirt with people you are not attracted to just to practise
The romantic window of opportunity is small: acquaintance, then signals (more time together, intimate touch like a hand on the chest, real cheek kisses); if you do not act, it usually closes for good
Friendships with women are valuable partly because female social proof and vouching open other opportunities
He considered chasing other women in his early 20s but chose to invest in his future wife; about seven years later he is glad he did
He regrets his playboy phase; it made it harder to attach to his wife

Approaching women at the gym: you are probably the 15th guy and disturb her focus; best in is being regulars who respect each other's work, then ask about her training goals; if she never initiates, she is not interested
Getting jacked so you never need to talk to women does not work; a good-looking statue gets opportunities, not results, and gym-maxxing alone stunts you socially
Men must not only adopt philosophies women approve of; his wife disagrees with many of his views and says she would be bored otherwise
Confidence comes from Mishima-style 'body heroism' and action, not daydreaming about being a hero; imagination should give context for action
Being called 'bro' by a woman means you are friendzoned
At 19, engagement can wait; a woman asking for commitment wants security, and refusing outright signals you want freedom
If most women ignore you, the problem is looks or, more likely, personality, not your clothing style
Seek closure after breakups unless there was something like cheating, so both can learn their faults
He is against long-distance relationships, having slept with many women who were in them
Body count matters partly culturally, partly as math: 100 partners by 25 means she does not vet men
Never date a woman who cheated on her partner with you
Natural men cannot get too muscular for women; women who dislike muscle mean steroid users
Boundaries are healthy distance; people who love you respect them and those who violate them are toxic
Social battery is like work capacity in the gym: trainable, but people start with different capacities
Verbal consent to kiss is overrated; read body language, move slowly, and she leans in or away
Paying prostitutes does not build relationship experience; it only makes you good at paying prostitutes
He barely drinks (a beer or two a year) and considers alcohol poison
Teasing is healthy flirting; negging is a despicable manipulation that only works on low self-esteem women
A woman who had casual sex in her 20s is not damaged; committed past relationships may make her more emotionally mature than an inexperienced man
Spending years in isolation 'gymcelling' to earn a woman later yields nothing; you punished yourself for nothing
Gymcelling = focusing intently on gym time believing a better body will solve all your problems; it does not
Extreme promiscuity is often a symptom of mental issues, unlike normal casual dating
If every relationship ends up purely sexual, you are the common denominator; slow down and build before sex
Sex creates emotional connection, especially for women
He claims about 10% of French people do not know their real father and unauthorised paternity tests in France risk up to a year in prison
A man in his 30s is still young for dating, with about 20 years of dating ahead if he keeps sharp
You cannot learn seduction from YouTube theory; you learn by practising like riding a horse
He has always given partners an ultimatum to quit smoking
If you get first dates but never second ones, your personality during the date is the problem
Grief is the consequence of love and always worth it; spend time with living parents rather than pushing them away
His goal when dating his wife was to make her independent enough to be fine if he died; making a partner dependent is manipulation
He values intelligence, kindness and looks in a partner; he was first drawn to his wife's height and glutes
Women who cheat show red flags that men ignore because the woman is attractive
Loneliness kills young men; seek community (church, mosque, campus) and prioritise mental health if isolation will last years
He refused to monetise the channel for years fearing greed; staying unmonetised to sponsors shows small allowances do not corrupt you, so do not hide your qualities
For a formerly fat partner afraid of the scale, run a very slow bulk of about 1 lb per month so he gets used to the scale rising without gaining much fat
Fear of rejection hurts more than rejection; most women reject kindly
He has an avoidant attachment style and his wife a codependent one; it works because both set boundaries and compromise
Anecdote: before a first intimate date he masturbated four times and ate a whole rotisserie chicken, fumbled, and that failure led to studying in America, meeting his wife and starting the channel
Short, fun relationships still give valuable experience; do not be black and white
Women like men with hobbies because it shows individuality, but they spot hobbies faked to attract women
The fear of being boring is worse than being boring; be passionate and enjoy yourself
To date a woman much more jacked than you, get more jacked than her first
Common interests are overrated; they can be built later, as with his wife
After one painful rejection in college he deliberately 'speedran' rejections until they stopped hurting
Cooking for a woman is a huge turn-on; most of his meals take about 10 minutes
When he started getting serious with his wife he was obese, around 240 lb with a double chin; being out of shape is no excuse to stop dating
Thinking 'I will be happy when X' is lying to yourself; choose to be happy now
New partners feel the same; the slight novelty never makes up for losing a long-term partner
Losing feelings right after sex means it was lust, not love; men must learn to tell them apart
Protect a body-image-insecure partner from trendy teenage steroid influencer content
Red flags in a woman: free drugs from a dealer, talking constantly about exes, talking about another guy
